system.description:
You have become wise and well-rounded by the standard of even fellow druids, and have begun to rival some wizards and witches in your knowledge of magic. You gain the following benefits:

  • Your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You gain an expertise die to your Nature skill. Your maximum expertise die size for nature increases to a d12.

  • You gain proficiency with the Arcana skill or an expertise die if you are already proficient.

  • You learn an additional wild shape form. It does not count against your number of wild shape forms known.

  • Choose the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.z5a26lxyh3esw2rl]{Speak with Animals} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.rek0fg987gg30wp9]{Speak with Plants} option you did not select with the Wildspeaker feat. You are constantly under the effects of the chosen spell.

  • Choose a druid spell of up to 6th level with at least one rare variant. You cannot select a spell of the Summoning school for this benefit. You learn a rare variant of the selected spell for free. You only need to prepare the base version of the selected spell and can choose to cast either the rare or base variant as you see fit when casting it.

Once you have taken this feat, you can no longer gain levels in non-druid classes.
system.prerequisite: Greenlord feat, Wildspeaker feat, 12 levels in druid, no levels in non-druid classes at time of feat acquisition
